timeline.summary: Rolex Rings announced a share buyback proposal worth up to ₹180 crore at ₹180 per share on April 23, 2026.
Rolex Rings announced a postal ballot notice to seek shareholder approval for a ₹180 crore share buyback at ₹180 per share.
Rolex Rings released its Investor Presentation for May 2026, highlighting FY26 financial performance, debt-free status, and a ₹180 Cr buyback.
Hardik Dhimantbhai Gandhi (Membership No. A39931) disclosed the Q4FY26 earnings call recording on May 18, 2026, available via the company’s website.
Rolex Rings released its Q4FY26 earnings call transcript, highlighting a debt-free status after settling its Right of Recompense and guiding for 15-17% revenue growth in FY27.
Manesh Dayashankar Madeka (Promoter) declared no substantial share acquisition by him or persons acting in concert during FY2026 except prior disclosures.
Rolex Rings published its public announcement for the ₹180 Cr share buyback at ₹180 per share with a record date of July 3, 2026.
Care Edge upgraded Rolex Rings' long-term rating to CARE A (Stable) and short-term rating to CARE A1.
